CanvasHistory.canvasView [canvasHistory.ts:346]
  create(name)
    save the current head as a new active view
  edit active view
    canvasViews().dirty compares content to the saved endpoint
      viewport and selection are ignored

    stash the active head in workingCopies
    load the target working copy or finalCheckpointId

  save(viewId?)
    checkpoint the current head; clear its working copy
  list/read         inspect views without switching
  start/stop/cancel legacy recording lifecycle
